name: Glass theme, light mode, over a window, from opening the panel to picking an app

media.caption: The Glass theme uses the system's most translucent glass. The window behind the panel stays sharp.
media.alt: A recording of Slick's search panel in the Glass theme, light mode. Slick's settings window, open on its About page, sits over a pale lavender wallpaper behind the panel. The theme's glass has no tint and no frost. Over the white page it is almost invisible, and only its edge shows where it crosses the grey sidebar. The app icon, the name and the lines of the About page stay sharp through it, and the panel's own text carries a soft light halo. The panel opens with Calendar, Music, Notes and Mail suggested. Typing “c”, “a” and “l” narrows the results. With “cal” the list shows Calendar, Calculator, Calculator History, Quit All Applications, Eject All Disks, Search Apple Maps and Create Quicklink. The selection moves down to Calculator. Command-K opens the action panel, a card of regular glass with a deeper tint, and closes it again. Return picks Calculator and the panel closes. The scenario notes the launch instead of opening the app. Recorded from the assembled app running a scripted scenario, with Apple's own apps and their real icons.
